tools.name: tax_trap_100k
tools.description: Whether adjusted net income falls in the Personal Allowance taper (£100,000 to £125,140), what it costs including lost Tax-Free Childcare and funded hours, and the pension salary sacrifice that would bring income back to £100,000. UK only. Guidance, not regulated financial advice.

tools.name: student_loan_overpay
tools.description: Whether overpaying a UK student loan (Plan 1, 2, 4, 5 or Postgraduate) reduces total repayments, or only hands over money that would otherwise be written off. UK only. Guidance, not regulated financial advice.

tools.name: mortgage_overpay_vs_savings
tools.description: Over the time left on a fixed-rate mortgage, the value of overpaying against saving the same monthly amount, after tax and the Personal Savings Allowance. Without savingsRate, uses the highest easy-access rate Candid tracks. UK only. Guidance, not regulated financial advice.
